name: web-dark-interior-studio-site-with-violet-accent-and-pale-gradient-type
title: Dark interior-design site in black with violet buttons, half-grey giant headlines and bracket labels
whatItIs: Two dark page columns on a violet-to-black backdrop: a left icon rail, giant 'INTERIOR STUDIO' where the second word is grey, bracketed monospace labels on a dotted line, white furniture cutouts in notched tiles, a violet 3D box wireframe for services, a slideshow, and a large faded 'Modulo' logo in the footer.
whatItMeans: Technical and elegant; brackets and dotted grids feel like blueprints for interiors.
techniques: Set the headline half white half grey.
Label sections with bracketed monospace tags.
Use notched cutout tiles for products.

vocabulary.definition: A monospace tag inside square brackets.
A tile with a cut corner.
A headline half bright, half dimmed.
A vertical strip of square icon buttons.
